edit.description: `isPickable` answers through `isPickableNow`, composing the settled-blocker set off `pending` with no second switch over `gate.kind`; the header names where the switch lives instead of claiming it
`isPickableNow`'s doc names both callers — the exported tooling read and selection's own

summary: The `gate.kind` switch is spelled twice — `isPickable` (`src/selection.ts`) and `isPickableNow` (`src/PendingSchema.ts`) — under a header claiming it is spelled in one place
acceptance: one switch over `gate.kind` decides pickability for both the engine's own selection and the exported tooling read, with the `blockedBy` arm's two inputs composed at the caller that holds each; `isPickableNow`'s exported signature is unchanged, and `src/selection.ts`'s header states the switch's home rather than claiming it
notes: Third body of this family: a74496eb, 73a9228f, this one. Verified on disk: `isPickable` (`src/selection.ts:54`) and `isPickableNow` (`src/PendingSchema.ts:850`) each switch the whole union, differing only in how `blockedBy` is answered — absence from `pending` against membership in a shipped set — while `src/selection.ts:9`-`:13` says the switch is "spelled here alone". The exported form is public surface (`src/index.ts`, `FlumeApi`, `spec/pending.md`), so it is the home. Claims no property.
